faq.q: How much does Hayes Law charge?
faq.a: Hayes Law publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Hayes Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Hayes Law publishes a free initial consultation.
